assistant_visual_findings.method: Direct inspection of saved annotated corner and review montage, separate from computed pixel checks
findings: The upper glazed reveal is visible immediately left of the unchanged D1 upright post and joins the shallow side cap. It is narrow: two native translucent pixels wide.
The side run still uses shallow presentation. The full-height-to-cutaway step is now explicit in the saved adjacency view; it is not continuous equal-height rail geometry.
The clean and annotated corner are enlarged separately. The old v1 image remains visible for comparison; labels remain outside the artwork except geometric guide lines in the annotated view.
A human must decide whether the abrupt cutaway and narrow return read intentionally in gameplay. These images do not establish readiness for final appearance.
